nodes.label: Coding Style
nodes.description: Coding standards, naming conventions, formatting rules, and best practices for entire project.

nodes.label: Component-Service-API Separation
nodes.description: API calls must be separated from UI components; Component -> Service -> API pattern.

nodes.label: PEP 8 Python
nodes.description: Python backend code must follow PEP 8 style with type hints and proper formatting.

nodes.label: Small Functions
nodes.description: Functions should do one thing, have clear names, be small, and avoid too many parameters.

nodes.label: No Duplicate Code
nodes.description: Before writing new code, search existing code; reuse or refactor, do not copy-paste.
